plan: Drive: from District of Vanderhoof, about 99 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.51081, -123.22492, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 700 m SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 12 m, about 15 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2008 cutblock (950 m W) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-12, Region 7A. Season: mule deer 4 point bucks Oct 1 to Nov 15 and more rows (synopsis page 57, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-06, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AA-deer-walk-0004.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 7-12: about 7,996 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 1.53 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.7 km and about 12 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
